meta.title: Since AI Hackathon 2026 - venue interior specs (BioCity, Joki, EduCity) for the 3D digital twin
meta.conventions: All coordinates in metres. Each item gives "plan" (building plan frame, see frames) and "local" (shared frame: origin BioCity centroid, x east, z south). Bearings are clockwise from plan-up (-z) unless stated "local bearing" (clockwise from north). Areas from polygons unless "stated".
meta.confidence_scale: high = read from vector CAD (+-0.1 m); medium = raster/schematic (+-0.3..0.5 m); low = estimate/inferred
meta.publishing: Annotated production plans (emergency routes HATAPOISTUMISTIE, volunteer spaces, red marks) are INTERNAL - geometry only, do not publish routes.

local.axes: x east, z south (north = -z), y up, metres
local.anisotropy_note: This task frame is 0.25 % short in x and 0.79 % short in z vs true WGS84 metres (true m/deg at this latitude: 55041.6 lon, 111420 lat). Plans are true metres. Transforms below are rigid fits in the task frame (consistent with OSM-derived geometry); expect <=0.4 m scale mismatch across a building. Fitting in true metres changes BioCity rotation by 0.02 deg / translation by 0.1 m and gives scale 0.9987 (plan 1:250 confirmed).

issues.text: Setup drawing shows 13x4 = 52 tables; legend says 56 tables / 280 seats. Two variants given (A drawn, B legend).

Official plan has retail glass fronts at B z 4.05 (x -11.05..13.95); setup drawing base has the lobby to z 6.15, so its lower table row would overlap the shop fronts. 2x3.6 m blocks + 1.8 m walkway exactly fill z -4.95..4.05.
Stand 1 (Red Hat) and 3 hotspots sit 0.46 m from the double columns at B (+-6.0,-30.95).
Stand 4 hotspot lies in the "Ravintolan sisaterassi" box of the 3 Oct setup plan.
jokiTower.ts places floors 2-3 in the 2-3 sheet axes; they must be rotated +16.36 deg (about tower centre) to match floor 1 (stair is N-S in J on all floors).
LED wall drawn at r 8.40-8.50 (inner wall face 8.62), existing scene uses 8.95.
Since AI map puts counters at bearings 186.7..341.2 (step ~31 deg); scene uses 212..338 (step 25.2).
Entrance annex 41.7 m on TUAS map vs 44.5 m in OSM; 2022 ortho supports TUAS.
West main entrance: revolving-door symbol at E z 74.6, flow arrow at z ~69, OSM entrance node at z 70.8 - exact door position +-3 m.
Joki 12b door: plan glass line z 58.8 vs OSM node at canopy line z 62.6 (J).
No elevations except BioCity lobby +23.264. Joki/BioCity level difference (~1.6-1.8 m) and floor heights are estimates.
